subject: Request: provisional rebate for service deprecation impact
messages:
From: Dana Cole <dana@brightpay.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — embed endpoint deprecation impact

Mina,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To recap — our engineering team discovered that the legacy embed-similarity endpoint is being deprecated next week and the replacement requires changes on our side to prefetch + KV caching. That work will slip our rollout of similarity-based recommendations by ~6 weeks.

This delay materially affects our Q3 product launch and revenue cadence. Given BrightPay committed to a pilot and budget based on the earlier timeline, we need to discuss a goodwill rebate or temporary rate adjustment while we bridge to the new flow. Can you help with provisional numbers and what your execs would be willing to approve quickly? We need something to present to our CFO by Friday.

Appreciate any fast guidance — Dana

--
Dana Cole
Head of Product, BrightPay
dana@brightpay.com
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Dana Cole <dana@brightpay.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — embed endpoint deprecation impact

Hi Dana —

Thanks for laying this out. Sorry for the disruption; we just learned about the scheduled deprecation when product rolled the runtime change. I will pull together provisional numbers and escalate to finance + product for an exec signoff.

Immediate plan: Ill propose a timeboxed rebate (30 days of 50% off generation tokens tied to recommendation endpoints) as an interim. I need to loop in our product lead and finance to confirm feasibility and any contractual implications. Will come back by EOD Thursday latest so you have something for your CFO.

Would you be able to share the estimated token volume for the impacted pilot so we can size the ask?

— Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-26T08:21:00Z
Subject: [ACTION] Provisional rebate request for BrightPay — needs exec OK by 5/30

Team —

BrightPay (deal BP-4827) just confirmed their similarity recommendation pilot will be delayed ~6 weeks due to our embed endpoint deprecation. Theyre asking for a short-term commercial accommodation to keep the pilot intact and avoid churn. Key facts:
- Impacted timeframe: expected rollout slip across June -> mid-July
- Customer ask: provisional rebate / rate adjustment for the period of the slip to preserve launch economics
- Customer business: mid-market payroll SaaS, strategic pilot (reference potential)

My proposed interim offer (to be approved by finance/exec):
- 30 days of 50% off generation token charges for the recommendation endpoints starting from 6/1 or from their cutover date, whichever is later
- Alternatively, a one-time $18,000 credit (whichever is more favorable to customer)
- Requires DocuSign amendment and accounting note (one-off promotional credit)

Questions for finance/product:
- Sean: can finance sign off on a one-time credit of up to $20k without CFO loop? If not, what level of approval is required and typical TAT?
- Kimberly: is product able to offer an engineered mitigation (prefetch guidance / temporary flag) that would reduce the customer's migration time? If product can accelerate a compatibility shim, we might reduce the commercial concession.
- Karthik: can you validate the pilot token volume estimate (Dana said pilot is ~4M tokens/month) and confirm the revenue delta to model the $ vs percent tradeoff?

Attachments: BrightPay_rebate_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf summary, includes projected token math and legal amendment draft).

Im asking for an exec nod (Laura) to proceed with the provisional offer by EOD 5/30 so Mina can get the CFO a proposal. If approved, Ill shepherd the DocuSign and accounting entries.

Thanks — Mina
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-29T14:42:00Z
Subject: Re: [ACTION] Provisional rebate request for BrightPay — needs exec OK by 5/30

Mina —

Finance notes: we can approve a promotional one-time credit up to $10k under delegated authority (rev ops allowance). Anything >$10k needs SVP finance / CRO approval. The $18k suggested would therefore require an additional signoff. Operational steps:
- If approved, we record as a promotional credit (non-recurring) and supply a credit memo.
- DocuSign amendment template is fine; please mark the accounting code as PROMO-REBATE so we can track.

Product input (cc Kimberly): if product can ship a lightweight compatibility guide and a small runtime flag backport, it would likely reduce the customer's integration time by 2–3 weeks. That would materially change the commercial exposure. Kimberly — can you confirm feasibility and ETA?

Happy to jump on a 20-min sync if we need to expedite the internal approval path.

— Sean
Director, Revenue Operations
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-30T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: [ACTION] Provisional rebate request for BrightPay — needs exec OK by 5/30

Team —

Thanks for the clear ask and the proposed options. Ive reviewed the customer context and value (pilot + reference potential). Given the short timeline to their CFO, I approve a provisional one-time credit of up to $18,000 on the following conditional basis:

1) Product must commit to the compatibility guidance or a short-term flag/backport that meaningfully reduces the migration window. Kimberly, please confirm plan and ship-by date within 48 hours.
2) Mina: document the amendment in DocuSign with the credit memo language and the explicit expiry (credit applies through 7/1). Use accounting code PROMO-REBATE.
3) This is a one-off commercial accommodation tied to this specific deprecation exposure and does not set pricing precedent. Include a short note to that effect in the amendment.

If all three boxes are satisfied Ill sign the approval email to finance to apply the credit. If product cannot deliver mitigation in the 48-hour window, cap approval at $10k under delegated authority.

Laura
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
